script.vo: Nobody looks at the corners of a bag. That's where they fail.
So the corners get a second layer of leather, set by hand.
Leather across the top where the weight hangs. Canvas below, where it doesn't.
The handles root into leather, never into cloth.
More work than a bag needs, and exactly why the fourth trip looks like the first.
The Weekender by Velantra. Discover yours.

Two hands press down and smooth it flat from the center outward, cream linen sleeves rolled to the forearm. The natural grain and warm reddish tan tone of the leather catch the soft light.
